tasks.label: C++: build (Debug)
tasks.detail: Configure and build cppsrc into output/build/Debug
tasks.command: cmake -S cppsrc -B output/build/Debug -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build output/build/Debug --target main

tasks.label: C++: build (Release)
tasks.detail: Configure and build cppsrc into output/build/Release
tasks.command: cmake -S cppsrc -B output/build/Release -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build output/build/Release --target main

tasks.label: ROS sandbox: build
tasks.detail: colcon build rossrc into output/rossrc (dev container)
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && colcon --log-base output/rossrc/log build --base-paths rossrc --build-base output/rossrc/build --install-base output/rossrc/install --symlink-install

tasks.label: ROS sandbox: self-check
tasks.detail: Launch the C++ talker and Python listener; exits after 5 messages
tasks.command: source output/rossrc/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch hello_py hello.launch.py max_messages:=5
